author_role: Native isolated JSON-observation publication and evaluation-only retry implementation; author tests and bounded integration verification.
classification: Explicit opt-in new protocol. Missing pre-B2 APIs are not counted as released behavior failures. Confirmed regressions below are implementation-draft defects.
conclusion: The scoped final integration passes the bounded 272-case run. Root owns full repository validation, source inventory, commits and remote verification.
implemented_contract: Canonical task directories remain lifecycle, compute, stop and effect authority. Explicit JSON evaluations use task/_evaluation_attempts/<attempt_id>/work; their entrypoint copy and input manifest are outside work.

Before Popen, pin the confirmed B1 training source, exact input artifact IDs and records, declared protocol and script bytes. Hash/copy outside the effect lock and SQLite transaction, then recheck captured identities inside the short writer.

Reserved manifest/output environment paths override inherited and configured values. Commands use an absolute interpreter and copied entrypoint. Existing legacy shared eval_output cannot skip the new protocol.

A successful bounded envelope records one independent raw-result artifact and zero through 32 observations. Zero/negative values and adapter-reported valid/invalid/unknown remain literal observations, not scientific qualifications.

Result artifacts, observations, compute/lifecycle closure and terminal IDs share the owned attempt transaction. End-of-writer readback checks both result tables and every pinned input artifact record after terminal-trigger side effects.

Deterministic malformed, missing or oversized output closes FAILED with zero observations; source, identity, storage and cleanup uncertainty remains HOLD. Failure diagnostics stay attempt-local, not in training metrics.

Explicit retry preserves all previous attempt directories, training artifacts, source reference, input records and protocol. It does not reselect latest training, rename shared outputs, or launch training.
Legacy default-off execution remains on its original path. Unsupported benchmark/bundle/lineage/managed qualification combinations fail explicitly; canonical sealed-file validation remains in force.
source_hash_note: The six author engine files were checked before the 272-case run and after it and the snapshot replay; unchanged. Shared helper/store hashes here are final read-only inventory, with independent pre/post verification in the separate reviewer report.

fault_boundaries: Real IdeaLake, generic execution attempts, confirmed B1 training completion, immutable artifact records, retry API, evaluator launch/monitor paths and SQLite terminal transactions.
Only process/GPU/provider boundaries are synthetic; no real GPU lease allocation or training execution is claimed.
Source hash mutation and post-preparation sealed mutation interleave at real read/prepare seams; captured identity checks, store and lifecycle authority are not mocked away.

ENOSPC at manifest publication and terminal compute file writing, SQL terminal triggers, stale callbacks and retained output file descriptors exercise actual temporary filesystem and SQLite boundaries.
limits: An entrypoint snapshot is not the full transitive closure of imported modules, interpreter packages, inherited environment, or datasets.
Attempt work directories and read-only snapshot files are cooperative boundaries, not a hostile same-UID process sandbox.

Prelaunch preparation can leave unbound staging and subsequent admission allocates a fresh attempt ID. No B1-style deduplication across prelaunch failures or automatic garbage collection/recovery is claimed.
Input manifest and generic attempt binding each have a 64 KiB metadata bound and may reject before 32 declared inputs. Rejection does not authorize Popen.
Filesystem publication and SQLite commit are not atomic; uncertain publication retains HOLD and may require explicit resolution.
Legacy shared-output evaluation is preserved but cannot claim this new observation provenance.

This slice does not implement observation-based ranking/selection/qualification, statistical repeat aggregation, explicit same-seed replication admission, a CPU executor, measured research benefit, or all of V1-05.
No paid provider, GPU workload, holdout read, commit, push, remote verification or full repository suite is claimed by this author evidence.
